changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_vacancy_grades RENAME TO krrg_grades;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_grades RENAME TO krrg_vacancy_grades;

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_grades ADD COLUMN level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE krrg_grades DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS level;

changeSet.author: Oleg V. Kryuchin
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO krrg_grades (code, name, level, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('JUNIOR', 'JUNIOR', 1, 1, now(), now()), ('JUNIOR_PLUS', 'JUNIOR+', 2, 2, now(), now()), ('MIDDLE', 'MIDDLE', 3, 3, now(), now()), ('MIDDLE_PLUS', 'MIDDLE+', 4, 4, now(), now()), ('SENIOR', 'SENIOR', 5, 5, now(), now()), ('STAFF', 'STAFF', 6, 6, now(), now()), ('PRINCIPAL', 'PRINCIPAL', 7, 7, now(), now()), ('LEAD', 'TEAM LEAD', 8, 8, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, level = EXCLUDED.level, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, updated_at = now() WHERE krrg_grades.name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.name OR krrg_grades.level IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.level OR krrg_grades.sort_order IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sort_order;
